'''Loedorvia''' was a celestial body located in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds']] [[Weemell sector/Legends|Weemell sector]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it was the site of a [[Battle of Loedorvia|battle]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. During that confrontation, Confederate [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] ordered the release on Loedorvia of the [[Disease/Legends|disease]] known as the [[Brainrot Plague]]. The act [[Death/Legends|killed]] tens of thousands of individuals and led to the deaths of nearly every [[Human/Legends|Human]] in the Weemell [[Sector/Legends|sector]].

==Description==
Loedorvia was a terrestrial astronomical object<ref name="TEA" /> located in the [[Loedorvia system/Legends|Loedorvia system]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds']] [[Weemell sector/Legends|Weemell sector]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
[[File:LoedorviaCloneWars-TEA.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Situated within Galactic Republic space, Loedorvia became the site of a battle during the Clone Wars.]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it was situated within the borders of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TEA" /> Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20.2 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the [[Battle of Duro (Clone Wars)|Battle of Duro]], which—along with the [[Battle of Loedorvia]]—is established by ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' to have been a part of [[Operation Durge's Lance]], to [[20 BBY/Legends|20.2 BBY]].</ref> Loedorvia was the site of<ref name="TEA" /> a [[Battle of Loedorvia|battle]] between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. During that confrontation, Confederate [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] ordered the release of<ref name="Season1" /> the [[Atmosphere/Legends|airborne]]<ref name="CSWE BrainrotPlague">{{CSWECite|I|90|Brainrot Plague (Loedorvian Brain Plague; Brainworm Rot)}}</ref> [[hive virus]]<ref name="Season1" /> [[Disease/Legends|disease]] known as the [[Brainrot Plague]]<ref name="CSWE BrainrotPlague" /> on Loedorvia.<ref name="TEA" />

The disease, also known as the Loedorvian Brain Plague,<ref name="CSWE BrainrotPlague" /> was unleashed from Grievous's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|''Providence''-class carrier/destroyer]] [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']],<ref name="DB TradeFederationCruiser">{{DB|starship|tradefederationcruiser|Trade Federation cruiser}}</ref> and the act [[Death/Legends|killed]] tens of thousands of individuals in a single stroke.<ref name="Lord of War">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/86/indexp2.html|text=The Story of General Grievous: Lord of War|int=The Story of General Grievous: Lord of War}}</ref> Before an [[Antidote/Legends|antidote]] could be discovered,<ref name="Season1" /> the resulting outbreak of the disease exterminated all of the Republic's [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Republic Military/Legends|forces]]—as well as nearly every [[Human/Legends|Human]]—in the Weemell [[Sector/Legends|sector]].<ref name="CSWE BrainrotPlague" /> The sector was also rendered temporarily uninhabitable as a result.<ref name="CSWE LoedorvianBrainPlague">{{CSWECite|II|259|Loedorvian Brain Plague}}</ref> The Loedorvian outbreak terrified the inhabitants of the Core Worlds and led to Republic [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] stepping up their efforts to catalogue known viruses and research potential corresponding antidotes.<ref name="Season1" />

==Behind the scenes==
Loedorvia was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square K-12. In two instances in the book, the celestial body's name is misspelled as "Loerdovia."<ref name="TEA" />
